attchmntText: Confidence Petroleum India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Confidence Petroleum India Limited announced the approval of its Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 13, 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 455,628 lacs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 12,638 lacs. Consolidated revenue from operations stood at Rs. 464,376 lacs, yielding a profit after tax of Rs. 13,172 lacs. The company reported total assets of Rs. 338,269 lacs on a standalone basis and Rs. 403,541 lacs on a consolidated basis as of September 30, 2026.
